Repository machinery. Not a tool and not a grant.

Tracked files here, none of them a tool call: `README.md`, `acquired-stream.yml`, `agrofood-cold-chain.yml`, `annotation-nise-loop.yml`, `annotations.yml`, `artifact-provenance.yml`, `atmosphere-engine.yml`, `bim-interop-runtime.yml` (150 more).

This folder does not opt for the easiest task in a set. Name the task.

A file in this folder is not a tool call. This folder is not a human console. Use `ncp_index_list` and the [project map](../../mcp/project-map.json). The [folder index](../../mcp/folder-index.json) lists every tracked folder. Reading this contract does not run a solver, bind a provider, or qualify a result. A PASS, a LOCAL check, or a completed graph is not a physical release.
